title: Find the Added Letter
description: You are given two lowercase strings `s` and `t`. String `t` is generated by randomly shuffling `s` and then adding one more lowercase letter at any position. Return the single letter that was added to `t` as a 1-character string.
constraints: s and t consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: Every character in s cancels out with its copy in t under XOR or character-code sum.
XOR all character codes in s and t; the remaining value is the added letter.

examples.explanation: 'e' is the extra character present in "abcde" but not "abcd".
Since s is empty, the only character 'y' in t is the added letter.
